name: Corpus Verification Paths
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = policy/data structure, `(O)` = operation. Named nodes map to source code.
Every source path terminates at the bounded Corpus verification surface.

                              CORPUS INTERACTION

 [D] DomainProfile policy
     `DomainProfile`; `SOURCE_CODE_PROFILE`; `DOCUMENT_PROFILE`
     src/domainProfile.ts:6-86; src/domainProfiles.ts:9-94
     Chooses Corpus/Evidence schemas; document mode adds Sections and Highlights.
        |
        | explorer tabs / source-or-Markdown presentation policy
        v
 (O) FileExplorerPanel Evidence reveal
     `diagramFileFilter`; `FileExplorerPanel.revealEntity`
     src/fileTree.ts:48-97; src/components/FileExplorerPanel.tsx:103-214,294-369
        +---- [B] file selection ------------------> direct Corpus browse
        +---- [E] associated `CodeEntity` --------> Evidence range, not arbitrary read

 (O) HighlightsTreePanel source entry
     `HighlightRecordV2`; `HighlightsTreePanel`; `App.revealHighlight`
     src/highlights.ts:11-47; src/components/HighlightsTreePanel.tsx:13-128; App.tsx:1744-1754
        +---- [E] restore persistent artifact lineage and linked source range

 [E] associated selection / persistent highlight
        |
        v
 (O) Evidence-to-Corpus view
     `selectEntity`; `openLinkedAnchor`; source workspace renderer
     src/components/CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx:76-194,318-365
     Resolves visible linked paths, selects exact ranges, and requests source.
        +---- [V] validated Evidence anchor -------> mediated source reveal

 [B] direct browse: bounded list/read ------------------+
 [V] mediated reveal: validate anchor/read/overlay -----+
        |
        v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CORPUS - AUTHORITATIVE VERIFICATION SURFACE                                                      |
|                                                                                                  |
|  (O) Bounded Corpus verification                                                                 |
|      `FilesystemCorpusProvider`; `DiagramApplication.sourceSnippet`;                             |
|      `DiagramApplication.listRepositoryDirectory`                                                |
|      server/corpus.ts:10-122; server/application.ts:2279-2303,2393-2408                          |
|      [B] safely lists and reads only bounded files.                                               |
|      [V] validates the Evidence anchor, reads its full document, and overlays captured lines.    |
|                                      |                                                           |
|                                      v                                                           |
|                         authoritative document + Evidence overlays                                |
|                                      |                                                           |
|             +------------------------+--------------------------+                                |
|             |                                                   |                                |
|  +-----------------------------------------------+  +----------------------------------------------------------+   |
|  | (O) SourceCodeView verification               |  | (O) Terminal Markdown and Sections                      |   |
|  | `SourceCodeView`                              |  | `TerminalMarkdownView`; `buildMarkdownSectionTree`;     |   |
|  | src/components/SourceCodeView.tsx:179-361     |  | src/components/TerminalMarkdownView.tsx:13-106         |   |
|  | exact line select/highlight; reversible       |  | src/components/MarkdownSectionsPanel.tsx:16-58,76-216  |   |
|  | compacted-span or graph-mapping expansion     |  | sandboxed render; outline/active section; section tree |   |
|  |                                               |  | selection and recent-jump replay entry points          |   |
|  +-----------------------------------------------+  +----------------------------------------------------------+   |
|                                                                                                  |
|  Verification means comparing Evidence with these authoritative full-document views.             |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                    | exact line / entity / section / persistent-highlight jumps
                    v
 (O) PaneNavigationApi history
     `PaneJumpDestination`; `PaneJumpHistoryEntry`; `PaneNavigationApi`
     src/panes/navigation.ts:3-96; App.tsx:356-371,1673-1720,2012-2029
     Activates and focuses destinations; records bounded deduplicated jumps; delays delivery
     until handlers exist; supports replay and clear for reversible source navigation.
                    +---- replay/focus ----> Evidence workspace, `SourceCodeView`, or Markdown section
